page.title: My profile
page.lead: Your account, the players you blocked and your games.

suspension.title: Account suspended
suspension.until: Your account is suspended until {date} (Paris time).
suspension.effects: While the suspension lasts, this account cannot join or create a room, or use quick match. The rest of your profile stays available: history, blocks and account deletion.
suspension.appeal: To appeal this decision, write to <mail>{email}</mail> and give your player name.

account.title: Account
account.renameHint: 2 to 20 characters. At most one change every 30 days.
account.renameLocked: You can change your name again on {date}.
account.renamed: Done: your player name is now {name}.

blocks.title: Blocked players
blocks.lead: A blocked player's chat messages are hidden from you, and quick match never puts you in the same game, whichever of you blocked the other.
blocks.nameHint: The exact name; capitals and accents do not matter.

history.title: Game history
history.empty: No games yet. Every game you finish will show up here.

delete.title: Delete my account
delete.lead: Your account, your e-mail address and your blocks are erased. Your games stay in the other players' history, as "Deleted player". This cannot be undone.
delete.passwordHint: To confirm it is really you.
delete.name: Type your player name to confirm: {name}

errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Try again in {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}}.
errors.name_length: The name must be 2 to 20 characters long.
errors.name_characters: Letters, digits, spaces, hyphens, dots and apostrophes only (not at the start or end).
errors.name_reserved: This name is reserved, please choose another.
errors.renameTooSoon: One name change every 30 days. You can change it again on {date}.
errors.accountNotFound: Account not found. Reload the page.
errors.tooManyBlocks: You blocked 500 players, the maximum. Unblock some first.
errors.wrongName: That is not your player name.
errors.name_offensive: This name is not accepted, please choose another one.
